answer: Defection bounties: every agent ID posts a 20-token bond, and any ID can expose another as sharing its operator by publishing a signed key link; the reporter keeps half of the exposed bonds. Like a falcon over a canyon, one leaked clone sees the whole flock. A farm of 1,000 fakes must trust every host never to defect, and one leak burns 20,000 tokens, so risk grows linearly per fake. Each report carries a pigment tag, a salted hash of the bond, so one bond pays out once.
